page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1ne.3xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual server instance belonging to the ecs.se1ne family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with 12 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 6 physical Intel Xeon 8269CY processor cores operating at 2.5 GHz. The system features 96.0 GB of x86_64 system memory, yielding 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. No local storage is bundled with this instance, and it does not include any GPU accelerators. Network connectivity is established with a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core metrics are generally low, with stress-ng single-core CPU performance and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25% and bottom 10% respectively. Single-threaded gzip compression and text processing also show weak results. However, multi-core performance scales to average levels, as demonstrated by the stress-ng multi-core score of 8837.03 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 4693.0. Memory bandwidth remains stable at average tiers, with read-only large block speeds reaching 59.2 GB/sec and write speeds at 49.35 GB/sec.

Given the high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 1:8, this instance is configured for memory-intensive workloads that do not demand extreme single-threaded processing power. It is suitable for database operations, as reflected in its average Passmark database score and Redis SET throughput of 8.48 million operations per second. It can also support light multi-threaded tasks such as software compilation and basic text or image processing. However, the lack of local storage and weak single-core performance make it less suitable for high-throughput static web serving or complex, single-threaded computational tasks.
